title: Newest Demo To My Hero Focused Tower Defense Game
author: Kingnorik
selftext:
[itch.io link](https://kingnorik.itch.io/legends-loot-tower-defense)

I posted about a week ago about making my dream tower defense game. I have very fond memories of a somewhat obscure TD game from the early IOS days. It was called Magical Tower Defense. In that game the heroes were towers. And instead of upgrading them you had to manage specials, placement, etc. I haven't been able to find something close to that in a while and so I was inspired to make this game. Legends & Loot. I'm creating archetypes of some of my favorite RPG classes like Necromancers, Paladins, and my favorite the Inn Keeper, who special restores the parties health and leaves you with a Cold drink item, just like the good Inn Keeper he is.

  

Please provide any and all criticism, I just want people to play my game. Demo has 10 characters, 5 are locked behind achievements. There is so much gameplay in this demo. An endless dungeon extraction mode. Four areas, each with a bonus interlude stage. A challenger mode where you can only use certain heroes. And a chaotic endless dungeon where you only can choose 3 heroes and have to earn the other two. As well as hundreds of item combinations, and talents up to level 15. Right now I have 25 Legends and 7 areas. Much more on the way including PVP. I'm targeting Android/IOS for release but might also do a steam demo at least for more balance testing.

  

Game was made using vs code with Claude and Codex. Genned images in chat gpt. All the enemies are from a 3D game I was making last year before real life beat me up. I let Codex handle most visual things. Claude keeps the code together. I handle everything else, stats, the Legends, modes, items, talents, specials, balancing, etc.

Thank you for this! Visuals are my worst skill in game dev. I'm a systems guy, which is probably why I embraced AI so fast. I get excited reading character description and talent trees lol. 
  
There is a lighting system baked in but yea it's not doing a good job. I'll play with it.
